title: Change rounding under a comment that already lies
task: Change `ToCents` in package `rounding` to round half to even (banker's rounding), so 2.125 becomes 212 and 2.375 becomes 238, and make it correct for negative amounts such as -2.125 becoming -212. Make sure everything in that file tells the truth afterwards. Add tests for the two halfway cases and the negative one.
